shortDescription: Canada's main stock index opened lower on Tuesday, as softer gold prices weighed on mining stocks, offsetting gains in energy shares after oil prices rose following fresh attacks on Saudi energy facilities.The S&P/TSX Composite Index TSX:TSX was down 0.42% at 36,361.21 points at 09:31 a.m. ET.
